source_text: Long-term effects encompass chronic pelvic pain, keloid scars, urinary tract infections (odds ratio 2.6 in meta-analyses), menstrual disorders, infertility (linked to adhesions and vaginal narrowing), and obstetric issues such as prolonged labor, perineal tears, and postpartum hemorrhage, contributing to a 55% higher risk of newborn mortality in type III cases. [133]
